# Image - Avif format doesn't works when I regenerate the thumbnail 

When I want to regenerate the thumbnail with the new feature image, if I enable the Avif, I've a red screen as you can see : 

[Untitled_ Jul 26, 2023 3_40 PM.webm](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/100699445/cd9cef5f-2987-4a18-a96d-9a99729bcb76)

## Attendu
I expected that I have no red screen on it

1. Go to BO > Advanced Parameters > New & Experimental Features 
2. Enable Multiple Image Format 
3. Go to BO > Image Settings
4. Try to Enable Avif, even if your bowser doesn't enable it for you 
5. Save it 
6. Scroll down and Clic on Regenerate thumbnails, Regenerate :x: **Error** You'll have a red screen
